purpose: Virtual-only comparison; no research result can configure account execution
development_data: public-sample.json (previously inspected; never called unseen again)
benchmarks: All 23 earlier references retained without changes to their default settlement rules
no_trade: No selected strategy, no fallback, no projected stake, zero selected exposure; benchmark studies remain separate
stop_rule: Freeze implementation before reading evaluation data. No parameter tuning after inspecting test results. Fixes after unblinding must be disclosed and the data cannot be relabelled unseen.
pricing: Reuse saved public quote scenarios, not historical executable or authenticated prices. Haircut is an adverse sensitivity scenario, not an asserted actual fee.
evidence_limit: Concentration bounds assume independent bounded binary returns. They do not prove a persistent edge or account-executable profitability. No three-month forward test is claimed.
